statement: inspectChangeArtifact excludes the recording quest's OWN solve/ bookkeeping from the workflow-scope classification of a working-tree (diff:) change artifact — mirroring the exclusion the commit: range path already applies — and the bookkeeping subtree list gains 'evidence' so a quest's own solve/evidence/<id> receipt files ride inside its --auto-diff artifact without tripping the foreign-workflow refusal. Without this, any runtime quest whose sealed doneWhen evidence lives under solve/evidence/ (the test-receipt probe pattern) can never record an --auto-diff attempt: the quest file and receipt are swept into the diff and classified as foreign workflow paths. doneWhen: solve/oracle/changeref-own-quest-evidence-bookkeeping.json is done only when the focused change-artifact test suite passes with a case proving own-quest solve/evidence and solve/quests paths are excluded while foreign workflow paths still refuse.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The exclusion must stay narrow: it matches only the recording quest's id-scoped solve/ subtrees and the shared frontier-board projection; foreign workflow paths (scripts/solve/, another quest's solve/ tree, package.json, docs/steering/) in the same diff are STILL refused.
